title: Surviving Against All Odds
description: It is just a modpack about guns
body:
# This mod pack is designed for players who want to increase the game's difficulty. It adds firearms, introduces more monsters, and includes a shop system.
## 🧌Monster
added[H+](https://modrinth.com/mod/h_plus),[endofdays](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/endofdays),[Zombie Awareness](https://modrinth.com/mod/zombie-awareness).The game's difficulty has increased, and monsters gradually grow stronger over time, making survival more challenging.
## 🔫guns
added[TaCZ](https://modrinth.com/mod/timeless-and-classics-zero),It makes it easier for you to survive the apocalypse, experience the thrill of shooting zombies, or... point a gun at your teammates.
## tasks
added[FTB Quests](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ftb-quests-forge).Complete missions to earn supplies and survive the apocalypse.
## 🏪shop
End of Days features a built-in shop system. You can collect currency from zombie corpses and use it to purchase the supplies you need in the shop.
## 🎒Backpack
added[Sophisticated Backpacks](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-backpacks)so you can fit more in.
## 🏔️Terrain
added[Epic Terrain](https://modrinth.com/datapack/epicterrain),Fill your world with greater rivers, mountains, and plains to help you build shelters
## ⚡Optimization
It includes a wide range of optimization mods, ensuring you can play smoothly.
